item.wathe.blackout.tooltip:
Turn off all lights aboard for 15 to 20 seconds
Use your instinct to see your targets in the dark
Activated instantly on purchase
item.wathe.body_bag.tooltip:
Use on a dead body to bag it up and remove it
Single use
item.wathe.crowbar.tooltip: Use on any door to open it permanently
item.wathe.derringer.tooltip:
Point, right-click and shoot
Can only be shot once, so make it count!
Shot is replenished after a kill
item.wathe.firecracker.tooltip:
Detonates 15 seconds after being placed on ground
Good to simulate gunshots and lure people
item.wathe.grenade.tooltip:
Right-click to throw, explodes on impact
Good to clear groups of people, but be wary of the blast radius!
Single use
item.wathe.knife.tooltip:
Right-click, hold for a second and get close to your victim
After a kill, cannot be used for 1 minute
Attack to knock back / push a player (no cooldown)
item.wathe.lockpick.tooltip:
Use on any locked door to open it (no cooldown)
Sneak-use on a door to jam it for 1 minute
item.wathe.note.tooltip:
Write a message and pin it for others to see
Sneak-use to write a message, then use on a wall or floor to place
Invisible in hand
item.wathe.poison_vial.tooltip: Slip in food or drinks to poison the next pickup
item.wathe.psycho_mode.tooltip:
"Do you like hurting other people?"
Hides your identity and allows you to go crazy with a bat for 30 seconds
Bat kills on full swing and cannot be unselected for the duration of the ability
Gain a shield for the duration of the ability that can block one fatal attack
Activated instantly upon purchase
item.wathe.revolver.tooltip:
Point, right-click and shoot
Drops if you kill an innocent(unless you are Licensed Villain)

Does not drop upon killing Executioner targets
item.wathe.scorpion.tooltip:
Slip in a bed to poison the next person looking for a rest
Connected beds count as one bed, so you can't use it on both of them
 but the player will get poisoned if they sleep on any of the connected beds
